title: Argue with a digital approximation of me
description: An AI experiment on Delphi. Try an argument on a digital approximation of Benjamin P Taylor, then say what helped or went wrong.
intro: I've put an AI version of myself on Delphi. A bit of fun, and a chance to find out which of my habits survive being turned into software. Possibly the irritating ones.
howToTry: Ask it about an idea, challenge an argument, or try a practical question. Delphi generates the replies. Check what it says against the sources, and decide whether it helps.
externalService: The chat runs on Delphi, under Delphi's terms and privacy arrangements. This page only links to it; opening the page doesn't start a chat or send Delphi any information.
feedback: Tell me what you asked, what worked, and what went wrong. Include a reply or an excerpt if you can, with anything private removed. An example gives me something to work with.
